title: Elevator to the Ocean Floor
caption:
Elevator to the Ocean Floor 🌊🛗
This elevator goes 10,000 meters under the sea. Every time something breaks, we build a fix: steel walls, floodlights, a cage, four cables. At the bottom? A glowing house.

Would you live down here for a year? Comment below. Tag a friend who would. Follow @StickMindR8 for the next build.

#buildit #stickman #animation #storytime #reelsinstagram
